text:
pagerbot: PagerDuty -> PD-4521 fired: `embed-queue-io-surge` in us-west-dedicated. 5xx rate increased across dedicated pools. Paging rotation -> maya (on-call). Link: https://pd.inc/PD-4521

maya (on-call): Acked. I'm on it — triage handoff to eng-sre. @samir can you take lead and join the bridge?

samir: Taking it. joining the bridge now. Quick snapshot: KV eviction rates shot up ~2m ago, and several nodes report OOM kills. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/embeds/us-west

alex: FYI I noticed a mem regression in embed-processor 0.3.2 in the last deploy window. If OOMs match that timeframe, suggest rollback to 0.3.1 on dedicated pools. Runbook snippet:

```bash
# rollback deploy to last stable
kubectl rollout undo deploy/embed-processor -n inference --to-revision=15
# scale temporarily if needed
kubectl scale deploy/embed-processor -n inference --replicas=4
```

maya (on-call): Good call. Samir, coordinate rollback with deploy team. Also set a temporary ingress throttle for embeddings to reduce pressure: `redwoodctl throttle set --pool dedicated-us-west --rate 10r/s`

samir: Rollback started by me (triggered the rollback command). Deploy bot reports job queued. ETA ~2m for new pods.

deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated by samir on deploy/embed-processor (namespace: inference). Revision: 15.

samir: New pods up, terminating old ones. Early signs: 503 spike subsiding, KV eviction decreasing. Watching logs for restarts.

elaine: Noted. Any immediate customer impact?

cs-jordan: CS here — pulling affected customer list (customer-alpha, customer-beta, customer-gamma). Sending a brief to them now about degraded embedding latency and that we're mitigating. Will update when rollback completes.

alex: Also toggle the duplicate fanout suppression rule: looks like autopage de-dupe didn't catch this and we got multiple pages. Suggest disabling the problematic rule until we patch: `pagerdutyctl rule disable dp-embed-fanout`

maya (on-call): Confirmed 503s have dropped back to baseline in the last 60s. Keeping monitoring window open for 10 more minutes. Great work. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PagerDuty -> PD-4521 updated: resolved by maya (on-call). Duration ~12m. Notes: rollback to 0.3.1; temporary throttle applied; CS notified. Postmortem requested and assigned to eng-runtime + eng-sre. Link: https://incidents.redwood/PD-4521

maya (on-call): I'll open the incident doc and assign follow-ups: 1) root-cause (mem regression in 0.3.2), 2) fix autopage de-dupe rule and suppression logic, 3) add a pre-emptive autoscale guard for embed-processor. Samir, please include deploy logs and pod OOM traces in the doc.

samir: Will attach logs + timeline. Leaving monitoring on for 30m then close.

cs-jordan: I'll follow up with customers with final resolution and link to postmortem when ready.

maya (on-call): Closing thread here once monitoring window passes. Thanks all. :heart:
